name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that expand or collapse associated content panels. Supports single or multiple open sections simultaneously.

notes: Each section header is a <button> element with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Each panel has role='region' and aria-labelledby pointing to its trigger button.
Arrow keys move focus between header buttons.
Home/End move focus to first/last header.

items.type: Array<{ title: ReactNode; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }>
items.description: Array of accordion sections. Each item must have a title (string or ReactNode), content ReactNode, and an optional disabled flag.

allowMultiple.description: When true, multiple sections can be open simultaneously.

defaultExpanded.description: Indices of sections that are expanded by default on first render.

disabled.description: When true, all accordion panels are disabled and cannot be toggled.

onChange.description: Called when the set of expanded items changes. Receives indices of expanded items as string array.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use for FAQs, settings panels, or any grouped content that benefits from progressive disclosure.
Provide concise, descriptive titles for each section.
Use allowMultiple when sections are independent and users may need to compare content.
dont: Do not nest Accordions inside Accordion panels — use a flat structure.
Do not use Accordion for navigation — use Tabs or a navigation menu instead.
Do not place critical required information inside a collapsed section.
